steps.name: roll forward to accepted version
steps.message: Frontbase CL-7 rollback rehearsal: restore accepted version

notes: Only the isolated app Worker named app was changed; its three exact CL-6 routes remained attached and the production wildcard route was not changed.

The health probe timestamps precede the Cloudflare audit query because clock progress during the provider listing explains the apparent ordering; the health responses were taken immediately after each deployment command.

The managed local execution sandbox denied nested Wrangler process spawning, so the two Wrangler rollback commands were invoked directly from the shell. The cloud-ops rollback command remains the repeatable operator path outside that sandbox and is covered by CLI parsing/tooling tests.
